Copper alloy coin fragment. Fractional nummus; a neatly defined quarter coin; possibly Trier mint, possibly of Magnentius (350-353); if so possibly Emperor standing left; Reece period 18, issue of 350-351. Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: (----)VS A(VG). Reverse description: booted bare leg of standing figure, possibly Emperor in military dress. Reverse inscription: possibly…
